layer_contracts.syntax: hash of exact expression spelling after line-ending normalization
layer_contracts.canonical: hash of semantic compiler canonical expression
layer_contracts.exact_signal: hash/fingerprint of exact materialized signal weights under declared universe and timestamps
layer_contracts.activation: hash of active/nonzero mask under declared universe and timestamps
layer_contracts.behaviour: observation-only identity from activation, sign, rank weight, selection, persistence, and symbol/month/session profiles under a declared coordinate contract
layer_contracts.pnl_regime: registered equivalence of net PnL vectors and regime-conditioned behavior under an explicit tolerance contract
layer_contracts.economic_hypothesis: manually registered causal/economic thesis with provenance; never inferred from accepted family or OOS rank

automatic_merge_rules: multiple syntax identities may map to one canonical identity
multiple canonical identities may map to one exact signal identity
multiple exact signals may map to one activation identity only from observed activation masks
activation identities may map to behaviour clusters only through the registered multi-metric B0A equivalence contract
PnL/regime equivalence requires registered net-return and regime artifacts
economic hypothesis equivalence requires explicit hypothesis registry decision
